name: Trade Transaction Identification 19
definition: Provides details on transaction and conducting counterparty.

ReportingCounterparty.name: Reporting Counterparty
ReportingCounterparty.definition: Unique code identifying the reporting counterparty.

OtherCounterparty.name: Other Counterparty
OtherCounterparty.definition: Unique code identifying the entity with which the reporting counterparty concluded the transaction.

EntityResponsibleForReport.name: Entity Responsible For Report
EntityResponsibleForReport.definition: Unique code identifying that the Financial counterparty responsible for reporting on behalf of the other counterparty.||USAGE : In the case where a management company is responsible for reporting on behalf of an Undertaking for Collective Investment in Transferable Securities (UCITS), the unique code identifying that management company. In the case where an Alternative Investment Fund Manager (AIFM) is responsible for reporting on behalf of an Alternative Investment Fund (AIF), the unique code identifying that AIFM.

UniqueTradeIdentifier.name: Unique Trade Identifier
UniqueTradeIdentifier.definition: Unique trade Identifier (UTI) as agreed with the counterparty.

MasterAgreement.name: Master Agreement
MasterAgreement.definition: Details related to the master agreement.

AgentLender.name: Agent Lender
AgentLender.definition: Identification of the agent lender involved in the securities lending transaction.

TripartyAgent.name: Triparty Agent
TripartyAgent.definition: Identification of the third party that administers the transaction.
